lines.zh: 四条腿轮着抬，走得不快。
lines.en: Four legs take turns. Not fast.

lines.zh: 我低着头走，牙露在外面。
lines.en: Head low, teeth showing.

lines.zh: 枯地上有我的脚印，很深。
lines.en: Deep prints of mine in the dead ground.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬不住，也合不上。
lines.en: My teeth won't close. Won't shut.

lines.zh: 嘴角一直流东西，擦不掉。
lines.en: Something runs from my mouth. Can't wipe it.
Every step, a bone clicks.
Nose to the ground, hunting a scent.
The group walks loose. I'm at the back.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，草都黑了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass blackens.
Walking and chewing at nothing.
I walk with a limp.

lines.zh: 这片枯地上，我们二十队。
lines.en: Twenty groups of us on this dead ground.
An old wound on my hind leg.

lines.zh: 我一直跟着前面那只的味道。
lines.en: I follow the scent of the one ahead.

lines.zh: 地面裂了缝，我踩着过去。
lines.en: Cracks in the ground. I walk over them.

lines.zh: 我停下来，闻了半天，再走。
lines.en: I stop, sniff a long while, then go on.
I stand. Teeth always showing.

lines.zh: 口水滴在枯草上，冒了一点烟。
lines.en: Drool hits dead grass and smokes.
You can count my ribs.

lines.zh: 我不睡，睡了就醒不过来。
lines.en: I don't sleep. I might not wake.

lines.zh: 风从我的牙缝里过，有声。
lines.en: Wind passes my teeth and whistles.

lines.zh: 我的眼皮很沉，眨眼要很久。
lines.en: My eyelids are heavy; blinking takes a long time.
The one beside me is staring too.
I sniff. Rot.

lines.zh: 我的舌头是灰的，收不回去。
lines.en: My tongue is grey. It won't go back in.

lines.zh: 站着的时候，我才觉得饿。
lines.en: Only standing still do I feel the hunger.

lines.zh: 我挠了挠胸口，掉下一块。
lines.en: I scratch my chest. A piece falls off.

lines.zh: 枯草在我脚边自己断了。
lines.en: Dead grass snaps by my feet.
Footsteps far off. I hear them.
I've stopped. It saves more.
My jaws clack together.
My eyes turn in hollow sockets.

lines.zh: 你站那儿，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: Standing there. I see you clearly.
My teeth don't meet. Look.
My neck tilts. Bones click.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，勾得我牙痒。
lines.en: The heat coming off you makes my teeth itch.
I watch you, step by step.
Don't look between my teeth.
I lift a foreleg, then set it down.

lines.zh: 你退，我们几只都跟着转。
lines.en: You back up. All of us turn.

lines.zh: 这张脸，你今晚会想起来。
lines.en: You'll remember this face tonight.
A low growl from me. Muffled.
We look at each other. Who moves first?

lines.zh: 你手里那东西，我不认得。
lines.en: That in your hand. I don't know it.

lines.zh: 我掉了一块，走得更慢了。
lines.en: Lost a piece. Slower now.
Another tooth came loose.
I backed off. Limping worse.
This body was nearly done anyway.

lines.zh: 你打哪儿不好，打这条腿。
lines.en: Anywhere but this leg.
I growled. My throat cracked.
The others closed in to shield me.
Rot water seeps from the wound.
I braced on the ground and stood.
Pain or not, I can't tell now.
Meat. You smell of meat.
Throw it. My teeth can hold it.
Rotten is fine. I'm not picky.
I limp toward it.
You're too far. Out of reach.
Swallowing is hard for me.
That bite takes me a long time.
All of us smelled it.

lines.zh: 你别用手拿着，我怕咬到。
lines.en: Don't hold it in your hand. I might bite.

lines.zh: 饥饿原野上，牙先长出来。
lines.en: On the starved plains, teeth come first.
One more. My teeth are loose.
Sweet things? None here.

lines.zh: 我闻到你的汗了，比食物响。
lines.en: I smell your sweat. Louder than food.
A bit forward. Don't move.

lines.zh: 这东西卡在我牙缝里了。
lines.en: It's stuck between my teeth.
Eating never fills me.
You kicked me. My ribs rang.
I back off, one leg dragging.
A piece fell off. Don't step on it.
One bump and I'm crooked.
You got rot water on you.

lines.zh: 我们几只挤在一起，很臭。
lines.en: We crowd together. It's rank.
I go around you. Slowly.
My teeth scraped your legging.
I can't be bothered to pick up the tooth I knocked loose.
Don't stand behind me.
Among us. A pair would do.
Let's scent each other. Slow down.
This leg is bad. Don't mind it.
This land can't raise pups.
We follow the rot smell.
Tooth against tooth. That's a yes.
Come close. I smell strong.
The others are watching us.
After we eat, we'll talk.

lines.zh: 我们这队里，能生的不多。
lines.en: Few of us can breed.
I pick it up. My teeth won't grip.
Carrion on the ground. Mine.
I bit it. A tooth loosened.
No smell to this. Strange.
Once these rotting fangs bite, they don't let go.
One of them tried to take it. I growled.

lines.zh: 我把它甩来甩去，甩不动。
lines.en: I shake it. It won't come loose.

lines.zh: 我的牙缝里，塞着干了的血。
lines.en: Dried blood is packed between my teeth.
Yours? I took it for meat.
I carry it. Drool keeps running.
You moved. I heard.

lines.zh: 我们几只都把头转过来了。
lines.en: All our heads turned.

lines.zh: 这原野上就你一个活的。
lines.en: You're the only living thing here.

lines.zh: 我的牙朝你的方向张着。
lines.en: My teeth gape toward you.
You're warm. I can smell it.
Head low. Forelegs braced.

lines.zh: 你不该走到枯地中间来。
lines.en: You shouldn't have come to the middle of this dead land.
Toward you, step by step. Slow.
Of this group, I saw you first.

lines.zh: 我的前爪在土里按出了印。
lines.en: My forepaw pressed a print into the soil.
Limping, but not stopping.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我们几只一起挪。
lines.en: You step back. We all shift.
My jaws keep clacking. Can't stop.

lines.zh: 你绕到坡上，我们也上去。
lines.en: You take the slope. We follow.

lines.zh: 我闻着你的汗，越走越快。
lines.en: Your sweat. I'm getting faster.

lines.zh: 枯草被我们踩成一条路。
lines.en: We've trampled a path through the dead grass.
Weapon up. I keep coming.

lines.zh: 这地方没有水，你跑不远。
lines.en: No water here. You won't get far.
Drool marks my whole trail.
A little closer now.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，牙咬住你的袖子。
lines.en: I lunge. Teeth in your sleeve.
That bite. My jaw is weak.
Claws rake your calf.

lines.zh: 你把我踹开，我滚了一圈。
lines.en: You kicked me off. I rolled.
One of mine lunged from the side.
Rot water on your face. It stings.

lines.zh: 我咬着不放，其实咬不住。
lines.en: I hold on. Barely.
You retreated. I lost a tooth.
That knocked you off balance.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把嘴里的东西甩出去。
lines.en: I shake my head. Whatever I had flies out.

lines.zh: 我从枯草里爬出来，牙先露。
lines.en: I crawl from the dead grass. Teeth first.
Four of us joined this area.
I stand. Dirt falls off.

lines.zh: 风里有腐味，那是我带来的。
lines.en: Rot on the wind. I brought it.

lines.zh: 我们几只一起从地下拱出来。
lines.en: We pushed up out of the ground together.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，第一口气是苦的。
lines.en: I open my mouth. First breath is bitter.
This ground was dead already.
Companions first, then food.
The moment I landed, my leg went lame.

lines.zh: 你听见牙关了？那是我们。
lines.en: Hear the jaw clatter? That's us.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我身上的油味更冲。
lines.en: Fire makes my grease smell worse.
Fell. My leg bone went out of place.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我连咳都咳不出。
lines.en: Water in. I can't even cough.
The blast scattered several of us.

lines.zh: 有东西扎在我肋骨之间。
lines.en: Something stuck between my ribs.
That light pulls the rot inward.

lines.zh: 我饿得连叫都叫不出来。
lines.en: Too hungry to even growl.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我牙缝里都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning. Even between my teeth lit up.
Falling. Teeth still open.
